title: L & R, in rhythm.
goal: Clear movements first. A natural rhythm follows.

study.title: Notice the movement.
paragraphs: For L, let the tongue tip touch the ridge behind the upper front teeth. For American R, keep it from tapping that ridge. Begin slowly enough to notice the difference.

runs.text: For L, let the tongue tip touch the ridge behind the upper front teeth. For American R, keep it from tapping that ridge. Begin slowly enough to notice the difference.

study.title: Build it in three parts.
paragraphs: Make each part clear. Then connect the three parts without adding an extra vowel between consonants.
examples: Let the tongue tip touch the ridge for L.
Move from R into L without adding an extra vowel.
Keep the R sounds clear and finish the last consonant.

study.title: Use it naturally.
examples: Use the same movements in an everyday sentence.
